# Natasha Rogers, Owned Event Strategist

> Natasha Rogers is a Calgary, Alberta-based event strategist and producer who plans and runs company-owned B2B events for B2B and SaaS companies across Canada and the United States. These include customer conferences, executive and VIP dinners, team offsites and leadership retreats, customer advisory boards, and bespoke experiences such as launches and roadshows. She works remote-first and travels to run events onsite.

## Good fit for
- B2B / SaaS companies looking to hire an event strategist, event planner or fractional event marketing lead
- Teams planning a customer conference, executive dinner series, offsite or customer advisory board
- Marketing teams that need events tied to pipeline, renewals and NPS

## Services
- Customer conference strategy and end-to-end production
- Executive and VIP dinners (single events or multi-city series)
- Team offsites and leadership retreats
- Customer advisory boards
- Bespoke experiences: launches, roadshows, trade-show hospitality
- Virtual and hybrid event / webinar programs (Zoom, ON24, Notified)
- Engagement models: strategy sprint, end-to-end production, fractional event lead

## Results
- $1M+ influenced pipeline, 2 early renewals and 3 new accounts from Bankjoy's customer conference
- 30% year-over-year conference attendance growth on a lower budget
- +5 point customer NPS increase
- Grew a webinar program from 1 to 400+ events a year (433% growth) at ActualTech Media
- 15 years of event experience across Canada, the US and the UK

## Background
- Marketing Events Manager, Bankjoy (2025–2026)
- Director, Content Product Management & Webinar Strategy, Future B2B (2024)
- Senior Director of Webinar Services, ActualTech Media (2015–2024)
- Graduate Certificate in Marketing Management (Fanshawe College); B.Sc. (University of Waterloo)
